level_guidance.A1: Use A1 (beginner) wording only: very short sentences, basic vocabulary, present tense where possible.
level_guidance.A2: Use A2 (elementary) wording: simple connected sentences, frequent everyday vocabulary, limited subordination.
level_guidance.B1: Use B1 (intermediate) wording: clear standard language on familiar topics; avoid advanced idioms and complex literary phrasing.
level_guidance.B2: Use B2 (upper-intermediate) wording only: fluent but clearly non-native. Prefer common vocabulary and straightforward syntax. Avoid C1/C2 idioms, rhetorical flourishes, academic register, and near-native nuance.
level_guidance.C1: Use C1 (advanced) wording: sophisticated but natural; complex sentences allowed.
level_guidance.C2: Use C2 (proficient) wording: near-native precision and nuance.
level_guidance.native: Use native-speaker naturalness and idiomatic phrasing.

default_instructions_by_code.de: Verwende echte Umlaute (ä, ö, ü, ß) — niemals ae, oe, ue oder ss als Ersatz.

lines.level_cap: Do not use vocabulary, idioms, or sentence complexity above this level — even if examples, the CV, or style instructions suggest higher proficiency.
lines.preserve_formatting: Preserve formatting, line breaks, and markdown where present.
lines.output_only: Output only the translation — no preamble, notes, or quotes around the result.
